missions.title: Both Faces at the Same Stop
missions.stake: Aster’s next trainee needs a proof they can match to the setup that made it.
missions.knowledgeQuestion: What has to stay fixed when we compare traces from two faces of a tool?

objectives.title: Try both faces at one press stop and put the pair to use in the Cold Store.

journal.text: The plain workroom block left different marks on two strips at the same stop. I put the tested pair to use in the Cold Store and kept that stop with both traces. The Hawaiian beater has its own museum record.

hints.text: Equip the Hawaiian tapa cloth beater, Cleveland 1971.152. Look for the plain block in the Reconstruction Workroom.
Keep the strip stock and marked stop the same when you turn the block.
Make one proof with each face at Light or one with each face at Firm. Take that pair.
Bring the matched pair through the workroom door to Aster’s fitting table. Try the new arrangement at the low rail or at the east bench.
